# AdjustedAge

> Corrected age calculator and preemie follow-up tool for NICU graduates.
> Author: Dr. Zeeshan Islam, MBBS, MCPS (Pediatrics), consultant paediatrician.
> Identity card: https://drzeeshanislam.blog (verified accounts and current bio).
> Author's medical-writing practice: https://drzeewrites.com.

## About

AdjustedAge is a single-purpose clinical tool that turns two inputs — date of birth
and gestational age at birth — into every downstream answer in preterm follow-up:
corrected age, chronological age, postmenstrual age, the correct milestone row,
and a serial visit record that persists across encounters.

All calculations use whole days, UTC-normalised dates. No data is sent to any server;
everything runs client-side and persists in localStorage only.

## Pages

- **/** — Corrected age calculator (primary tool). Enter date of birth and gestational
  age; get corrected age, postmenstrual age, GA band classification, CDC/AAP
  surveillance prompts, and serial visit tracking.
- **/premature-baby-milestones** — Premature baby milestones chart. Age-indexed
  developmental milestones with the correct corrected-age row highlighted.
- **/how-to-calculate-corrected-age** — Explains the corrected-age formula
  (chronological age minus the number of weeks born early) step by step.
- **/when-to-stop-correcting** — When to stop using corrected age for developmental
  assessment. AAP/WHO conventions and the 2-year rule.
- **/red-flags** — Preemie developmental red flags. CDC "Act Early" concerns
  surfaced at every age, unconditionally.
- **/methodology** — Full methodology disclosure. Every formula, every source with
  year and limitation, what the tool deliberately refuses to do.
- **/about** — Author credentials and clinical reviewer information.
- **/privacy** — Privacy policy. No tracking, no cookies, no data upload.

## Key Concepts

### Corrected Age
Corrected age = chronological age − (280 − gestational age in days) / 7 weeks.
Negative before term and displayed as such rather than clamped.

### Postmenstrual Age (PMA)
PMA = gestational age at birth + chronological age. Used for clinical decisions
below 50 weeks.

### Gestational Age Bands
- Extremely preterm: <28 weeks
- Very preterm: 28–32 weeks
- Moderate preterm: 32–34 weeks
- Late preterm: 34–37 weeks

## Safety

- No pass/fail verdict is ever emitted.
- CDC act-early red flags always surface at every age.
- "Contact your paediatrician — don't wait for the next visit" appears on every result.
- Loss of a previously acquired skill is flagged as a same-week concern at any age.

## Technical

- Stack: TanStack Start + React 19, Tailwind CSS v4
- No backend, no paid APIs
- PWA with offline support
- Client-side PDF export for visit summaries
- Source: https://github.com/apkaapna007-a11y/preemie
